Services

The right expertise, and the capacity to use it, when you need it.

A small roster of experienced practitioners, and honest referrals to partners when your problem sits outside what we do well.

Technical Support→ Training & Education→ Strategy & Operations→ Artificial Intelligence→ Data Science→ Product and Engineering→

We have put together a core roster of experienced practitioners rather than a bench of generalists. When your problem sits inside what we do, you get someone who has done that exact thing before — not someone learning it on your budget.

When it sits outside what we do, we say so and connect you with a partner who does it properly. We would rather point you to the right person than bill you for the wrong one, and most engagements are a mix of these areas anyway.
